# PptxGenJS runtime

Source: https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS/releases/tag/v4.0.1

PptxGenJS 4.0.1 CommonJS runtime and TypeScript declarations, copied from the published npm package with normalized line endings. MIT license retained in LICENSE. The runtime imports JSZip; the unused package dependency on image-size is not distributed. EduPi uses this runtime through its native presentation tool.
